Strategy to reform the Judiciary
*161. DR. AKHILESH DAS: Will the
Minister of LAW AND JUSTICE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have evolved
a two pronged strategy on judicial reforms
both including appointment of Judges and
their accountability;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the steps taken or being taken to
adopt and implement the same?

SHRIMATI PREMA
CARIAPPA:

several institutes are mushrooming in the

Ayurveda and alternative system of
medicine and recently a six months'
course has been started by Vaidyanath
Research Foundation;
(b) if so, the steps Government have
taken to prevent mushrooming of such

Menace of spurious drugs
*163. SHRI RAMA SHANKER
KAUSHIK: Will the Minister of HEALTH
AND FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a meeting
was convened by her Ministry on 27th
January to deal with the menace of
spurious drugs in the market;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the composition of Committee under
Chairmanship of Dr. Mashelkar; and
(d) the action proposed by the said
Committee?
Insurance Scheme for Journalists
†*164. SHRI P.K. MAHESHWARI:
SHRI RAMACHANDRA
KHUNTIA:
 Will the Minister of INFORMATION
AND BROADCASTING be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government have

formulated any Insurance Scheme for
Journalists;
(b) if so, the provisions of this scheme
and to what extent Journalists are likely
to be benefited therefrom;
(c) the category of Journalists covered
under the scheme; and
(d) whether Government are
considering the Journalists in the category
of Reporters or Correspondents who
discharge their duties round the clock are
covered under the insurance scheme?
Mobile Diagnostic Treatment Clinics
in rural areas
*165. MISS MABEL REBELLO: Will
the Minister of HEALTH AND FAMILY
WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether there are Mobile
Diagnostic Treatment Clinics in the rural
areas run either by Central or State
Governments;
(b) if so, the details thereof, State-
wise;
(c) whether these clinics have the
required number of staff and medicines;
and
(d) the number of patients attended by
these mobile clinics during the last three
years, State-wise?
Byrd Amendment
*166. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that WTO has
upheld the plea of India and 10 other
countries that US Continued Dumping and
Subsidy Off set Act, 2000 (Byrd
Amendment) is inconsistent with WTO
agreements on anti-dumping and
subsidies and is in violation of global trade
rules;
(b) if so, its impact on Indian trade;
(c) whether India would get any
compensation from the US Government
or companies for the past cases covered
under the Act; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Special Economic Zones
*167. SHRI H.K. JAVARE GOWDA:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose
to set up Special Economic Zones
(SEZs) for the rapid growth of the
Electronics and Hardware sectors in
the country;
(b) if so, the details of amount required
for such SEZs;
(c) whether the State Government of
Karnataka has sought assistance from the
Government for the establishment of SEZs
in the State; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Promotion of social justice in J&K
*168. PROF. SAIF-UD-DIN SOZ:
Will the Minister of SOCIAL JUSTICE
AND EMPOWERMENT be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Jammu and Kashmir State
has been benefited from various schemes
devised by  the Ministry to promote social
justice in the State;
(b) whether Government are not
satisfied with the present level of
contribution to the J&K State; and
(c) if so, whether special attention is
proposed to be paid to the trouble torn
State?

out any strategy for growth of Industrial
Sector during the Tenth Five Year Plan
(2002—2007);
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) how the strategy is different from
the one adopted during the Ninth Five Year
Plan?

Rejection of Indian marine products
by foreign countries
1077. SHRI S.M. LAL JAN BASHA:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that many countries
have rejected marine product exports from
India recently due to hygiene problems;
(b) the details of countries who have
rejected Indian marine products exported in
2002-2003, so far;
(c) whether Government have taken any
steps to improve the image and quality of
Indian marine products;
(d) the details of such steps taken;
(e) whether more inspections are likely
to be Carried out of the premises where
such products are processed; and
(f) if so, the details thereof?
SEZs to promote investment in export
oriented activities
1078. SHRI S. S. AHLUWALIA: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state :
(a) whether it is a fact that Special
Economic Zones (SEZs) are being
established in various parts of the country
in order to promote investments in export
oriented activities;
(b) the difference between Export
Processing Zones (EPZs) and SEZs;
(c) the number of EPZs and SEZs
approved and established in the State of
Jharkhand;
(d) whether Government had announced
in the Exim Policy-2001 about setting up of
SEZs;
(e) the number of SEZs approved since
then and made operational so far; and
(f) the details of SEZs proposed to make
operational in the next two years?
Imports of cars, fruits and vegetables
etc.
1079. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there has been
steep increase in the imports of cars, fruits,
vegetables, milk and milk products during
2002;

241

(b) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor; and
(c) its impact on domestic manufacturers
and producers of these items?
Tea export
1080. SHRIMATI N. P. DURGA: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the quantity of tea exported during
the last three years, year-wise; and
(b) the details of steps being taken to
increase export of tea to Russia?
Decline in export of tea
1081. SHRI C. O. POULOSE: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the export of
tea from the country during the year 2002
fell by 6 per cent;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) the impact of this decline on the tea
producing areas along with the details of
loss in terms of foreign exchange earnings;
and
(d) the steps taken to improve the
situation?
FDI inflow
1082. SHRI P. PRABHAKAR
REDDY:
SHRI C. O. POULOSE:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the total FDI received in the country
during the last three years, year-wise;
(b) the comparative data of the same with
China during the said period;
(c) whether it is a fact that the contribution
of NRIs in the FDI inflow is much below in
comparison with their Chinese counterparts;
(d) if so, the percentage of investments
into their respective Nations of origin by
both the Chinese and Indian diasporas during
the last three years, year-wise; and
(e) whether Government have conducted
any study to ascertain the reasons for the
reluctance of NRIs investment in the
Country?
Patenting the Cow urine
1083. DR. AKHILESH DAS : Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether after Neem, Turmeric and
Basmati Rice comes a claim for patenting
under WTO regime Cow Urine for its
medicinal insecticide and cleansing qualities
and even the method of producing Atta
(flour) for US and foreign researchers and
entrepreneurs has been put forward; and
(b) if so, Government's reaction thereto
for protecting India's claim for the strictly
Indian know-how and traditional modes?
Export of tinned marine products
1084. SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
SHRI K. B. KRISHNA
MURTHY:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether our tinned marine products
are competitive in the international market;
(b) if so, the role Government propose
to play to boost the export of marine products
to international market; and
(c) if not, whether Government realise
the potential of exporting marine products
to the international market?
